Refer a clinician. Earn when they start.

Good clinicians know good clinicians. Tell us who you would vouch for, and earn a referral bonus when they start their first assignment.

How it works

Three steps, no catch

Tell us who

Share their name, profession and how to reach them. Make sure they know you are passing it on.

We take it from there

A recruiter gets in touch, learns what they want and shows them roles that fit.

You earn the bonus

When they start their first assignment, your bonus is on its way. Refer as many people as you like.

Make a referral

Who should we call?

You do not need to work with Mutex to refer someone. Anyone can.

Questions, answered

Frequently asked questions

Who can I refer?

Any nurse, therapist, technologist or allied health professional in a specialty we staff.

When is the bonus paid?

After the person you referred starts their first assignment. Your recruiter confirms the amount and the timing.

Is there a limit?

No. Refer as many people as you like.
